question: What Business Central AL guidance applies to a job queue handler that calls an external HTTP API and can be rerun after a failure?
answer: Propagate failures that invalidate the run so the dispatcher records them and applies configured retries (microsoft/knowledge/performance/job-queue-handlers-must-propagate-failures.md). Make external effects idempotent with a stable key enforced by the external service (…/job-queue-external-effects-must-be-idempotent.md). Do not call HttpClient inside an open write transaction; use an outbox processed by a job queue entry (…/httpclient-inside-write-transaction-holds-locks.md). Do not require UI in the handler (…/job-queue-handlers-must-not-require-ui.md). No retry count or policy is given.
